title:
Transform for `FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetCase>` for mapping the {@link ReliabilityAssetImportance#displayName} into the
{@link ReliabilityAssetImportance#importanceLevel} field.
This is done so that the {@link UiSdlCardList} component can "natively" support sorting by `importanceLevel` while displaying just `displayName`.
